epic.title: Transport Compliance & Document Management
epic.body: Centralized system to track, manage, and monitor the validity of critical legal and safety documents for vehicles and drivers, ensuring full regulatory compliance through real-time status tracking and automated expiry calculation.

features.title: Document Lifecycle Management
features.body: Enables administrators to perform full CRUD operations on compliance documents including insurance, pollution certificates, fitness certificates, and licenses.

stories.title: Compliance Document Dashboard and List View
stories.body: As a transport manager, I want to view a categorized list of all compliance documents with their current validity status so I can identify items requiring attention.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display cards for documents including Type, Vehicle/Owner Name, Doc Number, and Expiry Date.
Filtering: Provide tabs to filter documents by status: 'All', 'Expiring' (within 30 days), and 'Expired'.
Search: Enable real-time search by vehicle name, document type, or document number.
Analytics: Display summary cards showing total, valid, expiring, and expired counts.
Visual Cues: Use color-coded badges (Green/Orange/Red) and icons based on document status.

stories.title: Document Upload and Modification Workflow
stories.body: As a transport manager, I want to upload new documents and edit existing record details to keep the compliance database current.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload: Form to capture Vehicle Name, Document Type (Insurance, License, Tax, etc.), Doc Number, Issue Date, and Expiry Date.
File Support: Support for drag-and-drop or click-to-upload for images and PDFs with a preview mechanism.
Edit: Ability to modify metadata for existing records using a pre-populated form.
Validation: Ensure mandatory fields like vehicle name, type, and expiry date are provided before saving.

stories.title: Compliance Document Persistence and Processing
stories.body: Backend API to store document metadata, handle file uploads, and calculate expiry status logic.
acceptanceCriteria: POST/PUT: Endpoints to save document metadata and handle binary file storage/retrieval.
Logic: Automatically compute 'days left' and status (Valid/Expiring-Soon/Expired) based on the current date vs. the provided expiry date.
GET: Retrieve filtered lists of documents based on branch or organizational scope.
Download: Secure endpoint to retrieve and download stored document files.
